020public class Waystation extends BaseIndustry {
021        
022        public static float UPKEEP_MULT_PER_DEFICIT = 0.1f;
023        public static float BASE_ACCESSIBILITY = 0.1f;
024        
025        public static float IMPROVE_ACCESSIBILITY = 0.2f;
026        
027        public static float ALPHA_CORE_ACCESSIBILITY = 0.2f;
028        
029        public static float GAMMA_CORE_STOCKPILES = 0.1f;
030        public static float BETA_CORE_STOCKPILES = 0.2f;
031        public static float ALPHA_CORE_STOCKPILES = 0.5f;
032        
033        
034        public void apply() {
035                super.apply(true);
036                
037                int size = market.getSize();
038                
039                demand(Commodities.FUEL, size);
040                demand(Commodities.SUPPLIES, size);
041                demand(Commodities.CREW, size);
042                
043                demand(Commodities.VOLATILES, 1);
044                demand(Commodities.RARE_METALS, 1);
045                
046                String desc = getNameForModifier();
047                
048//              Pair<String, Integer> deficit = getUpkeepAffectingDeficit();
049//              if (deficit.two > 0) {
050//                      float loss = getUpkeepPenalty(deficit);
051//                      getUpkeep().modifyMult("deficit", 1f + loss, getDeficitText(deficit.one));
052//              } else {
053//                      getUpkeep().unmodifyMult("deficit");
054//              }
055                
056                market.setHasWaystation(true);
057                
058                float a = BASE_ACCESSIBILITY;
059                if (a > 0) {
060                        market.getAccessibilityMod().modifyFlat(getModId(0), a, desc);
061                }
062                
063                if (market.isPlayerOwned()) {
064                        SubmarketPlugin sub = Misc.getLocalResources(market);
065                        if (sub instanceof LocalResourcesSubmarketPlugin) {
066                                LocalResourcesSubmarketPlugin lr = (LocalResourcesSubmarketPlugin) sub;
067                                float mult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("stockpileMultExcess");
068                                lr.getStockpilingBonus(Commodities.FUEL).modifyFlat(getModId(0), size * mult);
069                                lr.getStockpilingBonus(Commodities.SUPPLIES).modifyFlat(getModId(0), size * mult);
070                                lr.getStockpilingBonus(Commodities.CREW).modifyFlat(getModId(0), size * mult);
071                                lr.getStockpilingBonus(Commodities.VOLATILES).modifyFlat(getModId(0), 1f * mult);
072                                lr.getStockpilingBonus(Commodities.RARE_METALS).modifyFlat(getModId(0), 1f * mult);
073                        }
074                }
075                
076                HyperspaceTopographyEventIntel intel = HyperspaceTopographyEventIntel.get();
077                if (intel != null && intel.isStageActive(Stage.SLIPSTREAM_DETECTION)) {
078                        market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.SLIPSTREAM_REVEAL_RANGE_LY_MOD).modifyFlat(
079                                                        getModId(0), HyperspaceTopographyEventIntel.WAYSTATION_BONUS, getNameForModifier());
080                }
081                
082                
083                if (!isFunctional()) {
084                        supply.clear();
085                        unapply();
086                }
087        }
088
089        @Override
090        public void unapply() {
091                super.unapply();
092                
093                market.setHasWaystation(false);
094                market.getAccessibilityMod().unmodifyFlat(getModId(0));
095                market.getAccessibilityMod().unmodifyFlat(getModId(1));
096                market.getAccessibilityMod().unmodifyFlat(getModId(2));
097                
098                market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.SLIPSTREAM_REVEAL_RANGE_LY_MOD).unmodifyFlat(getModId(0));
099                
100                if (market.isPlayerOwned()) {
101                        SubmarketPlugin sub = Misc.getLocalResources(market);
102                        if (sub instanceof LocalResourcesSubmarketPlugin) {
103                                LocalResourcesSubmarketPlugin lr = (LocalResourcesSubmarketPlugin) sub;
104                                // base bonuses
105                                lr.getStockpilingBonus(Commodities.FUEL).unmodifyFlat(getModId(0));
106                                lr.getStockpilingBonus(Commodities.SUPPLIES).unmodifyFlat(getModId(0));
107                                lr.getStockpilingBonus(Commodities.CREW).unmodifyFlat(getModId(0));
108                                lr.getStockpilingBonus(Commodities.VOLATILES).unmodifyFlat(getModId(0));
109                                lr.getStockpilingBonus(Commodities.RARE_METALS).unmodifyFlat(getModId(0));
110                        }
111                }
112        }
113        
114        protected float getUpkeepPenalty(Pair<String, Integer> deficit) {
115                float loss = deficit.two * UPKEEP_MULT_PER_DEFICIT;
116                if (loss < 0) loss = 0;
117                return loss;
118        }
119        
120        protected Pair<String, Integer> getUpkeepAffectingDeficit() {
121                return getMaxDeficit(Commodities.FUEL, Commodities.SUPPLIES, Commodities.CREW);
122        }

125        @Override
126        protected void addPostDescriptionSection(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, IndustryTooltipMode mode) {
127                if (!market.isPlayerOwned()) return;
128                        
129                float opad = 10f;
130                
131                tooltip.addPara("Increases the range at which slipstreams are detected around the colony by %s, once "
132                                + "the capability to do so is available.", opad, Misc.getHighlightColor(),
133                                "" + (int)HyperspaceTopographyEventIntel.WAYSTATION_BONUS); 
134                
135//              tooltip.addPara("As long as demand is met, allows the colony to stockpile fuel, supplies, and crew, even " +
136//                                              "if it does not produce them locally.", opad);
137        }
138
139        protected boolean hasPostDemandSection(boolean hasDemand, IndustryTooltipMode mode) {
140                return mode != IndustryTooltipMode.NORMAL || isFunctional();
141        }
142        
143        @Override
144        protected void addPostDemandSection(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean hasDemand, IndustryTooltipMode mode) {
145                if (mode != IndustryTooltipMode.NORMAL || isFunctional()) {                     
146                        MutableStat fake = new MutableStat(0);
147                        
148                        String desc = getNameForModifier();
149                        float a = BASE_ACCESSIBILITY;
150                        if (a > 0) {
151                                fake.modifyFlat(getModId(0), a, desc);
152                        }
153                        float total = a;
154                        String totalStr = "+" + (int)Math.round(total * 100f) + "%";
155                        Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
156                        if (total < 0) {
157                                h = Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
158                                totalStr = "" + (int)Math.round(total * 100f) + "%";
159                        }
160                        float opad = 10f;
161                        float pad = 3f;
162                        if (total >= 0) {
163                                tooltip.addPara("Accessibility bonus: %s", opad, h, totalStr);
164                        } else {
165                                tooltip.addPara("Accessibility penalty: %s", opad, h, totalStr);
166                        }
167                        
168                        tooltip.addPara("As long as demand is met, allows the colony to stockpile fuel, supplies, and crew, even " +
169                                                        "if it does not produce them locally. The stockpile levels exceed those generated by equivalent local production.", opad);
170                }
171        }

174        protected void applyGammaCoreModifiers() {
175                applyStockpilingModifiers(GAMMA_CORE_STOCKPILES);
176        }

186        
187        protected void applyStockpilingModifiers(float mult) {
188                if (market.isPlayerOwned()) {
189                        SubmarketPlugin sub = Misc.getLocalResources(market);
190                        if (sub instanceof LocalResourcesSubmarketPlugin) {
191                                //float bonus = market.getSize() * Global.getSettings().getFloat("stockpileMultExcess");
192                                float bonus = market.getSize() * mult;
193                                LocalResourcesSubmarketPlugin lr = (LocalResourcesSubmarketPlugin) sub;
194                                lr.getStockpilingBonus(Commodities.FUEL).modifyFlat(getModId(1), bonus);
195                                lr.getStockpilingBonus(Commodities.SUPPLIES).modifyFlat(getModId(1), bonus);
196                                lr.getStockpilingBonus(Commodities.CREW).modifyFlat(getModId(1), bonus);
197                                lr.getStockpilingBonus(Commodities.RARE_METALS).modifyFlat(getModId(1), bonus * 0.2f);
198                                lr.getStockpilingBonus(Commodities.VOLATILES).modifyFlat(getModId(1), bonus * 0.2f);
199                        }
200                }
201        }
202

204        protected void applyNoAICoreModifiers() {
205                if (market.isPlayerOwned()) {
206                        SubmarketPlugin sub = Misc.getLocalResources(market);
207                        if (sub instanceof LocalResourcesSubmarketPlugin) {
208                                LocalResourcesSubmarketPlugin lr = (LocalResourcesSubmarketPlugin) sub;
209                                lr.getStockpilingBonus(Commodities.FUEL).unmodifyFlat(getModId(1));
210                                lr.getStockpilingBonus(Commodities.SUPPLIES).unmodifyFlat(getModId(1));
211                                lr.getStockpilingBonus(Commodities.CREW).unmodifyFlat(getModId(1));
212                                lr.getStockpilingBonus(Commodities.RARE_METALS).unmodifyFlat(getModId(1));
213                                lr.getStockpilingBonus(Commodities.VOLATILES).unmodifyFlat(getModId(1));
214                        }
215                }
216        }

228        protected void addAlphaCoreDescription(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, AICoreDescriptionMode mode) {
229                float opad = 10f;
230                Color highlight = Misc.getHighlightColor();
231                
232                String pre = "Alpha-level AI core currently assigned. ";
233                if (mode == AICoreDescriptionMode.MANAGE_CORE_DIALOG_LIST || mode == AICoreDescriptionMode.INDUSTRY_TOOLTIP) {
234                        pre = "Alpha-level AI core. ";
235                }
236                if (mode == AICoreDescriptionMode.INDUSTRY_TOOLTIP) {
237                        CommoditySpecAPI coreSpec = Global.getSettings().getCommoditySpec(aiCoreId);
238                        TooltipMakerAPI text = tooltip.beginImageWithText(coreSpec.getIconName(), 48);
239                        text.addPara(pre + "Reduces upkeep cost by %s. " +
240                                        "Greatly increases stockpiles.", 0f, highlight,
241                                        "" + (int)((1f - UPKEEP_MULT) * 100f) + "%");
242                        tooltip.addImageWithText(opad);
243                        return;
244                }
245                tooltip.addPara(pre + "Reduces upkeep cost by %s. " +
246                                "Greatly increases stockpiles.", opad, highlight,
247                                "" + (int)((1f - UPKEEP_MULT) * 100f) + "%");
248        }

311        @Override
312        public boolean canImprove() {
313                return true;
314        }
315        
316        protected void applyImproveModifiers() {
317                if (isImproved()) {
318                        market.getAccessibilityMod().modifyFlat(getModId(3), IMPROVE_ACCESSIBILITY,
319                                                        getImprovementsDescForModifiers() + " (" + getNameForModifier() + ")");
320                } else {
321                        market.getAccessibilityMod().unmodifyFlat(getModId(3));
322                }
323        }
324        
325        public void addImproveDesc(TooltipMakerAPI info, ImprovementDescriptionMode mode) {
326                float opad = 10f;
327                Color highlight = Misc.getHighlightColor();
328                
329                float a = IMPROVE_ACCESSIBILITY;
330                String aStr = "" + (int)Math.round(a * 100f) + "%";
331                
332                if (mode == ImprovementDescriptionMode.INDUSTRY_TOOLTIP) {
333                        info.addPara("Accessibility increased by %s.", 0f, highlight, aStr);
334                } else {
335                        info.addPara("Increases accessibility by %s.", 0f, highlight, aStr);
336                }
337
338                info.addSpacer(opad);
339                super.addImproveDesc(info, mode);
340        }
